primaryMeasurements: Selected candidate count and exact distinct text count
Selected proof-based discourse marker plus lexical rewrite and discourse marker plus ending rewrite coverage
Set and order changes, by input group and intensity
secondaryMeasurements: N-gram/text overlap between selected candidates; descriptive, not a correctness or naturalness score
Selected transformation-category combinations; finite operation kinds, not sustained style or paragraph restructuring
Runtime and exceptions with same parser, assets, seed, settings and original input analyses
safetyMeasurements: Every selected candidate passes independent original-IR validation
S and Q remain null without trained human preference labels
Selected protected source entities, quantities, quoted contents and negation/uncertainty checks are compared through existing verifier, with manual source/output spot review
No new composition is counted solely from output string markers
comparability: Require exact byte hashes for baseline and after source/runtime modules and shared assets
Disclose candidate-pool, analysis, and verifier changes separately from selection changes
Full-text old-case overlap only; semantic near-duplicate independence is not claimed
interpretation: Measurements describe selection behavior and verified finite-edit coverage; no human naturalness, humor, Buront-likeness, or preference improvement labels are assigned.
